quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui & Co. TDnet: Update on the Previously Announced Non-binding Proposal (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mitsui & Co. (with its wholly owned subsidiary Mitsui & Co. (U.S.A.)) decided on October 15, 2026 to acquire, together with Penske Corporation, all of the free-float shares of Penske Automotive Group (NYSE: PAG) in a going-private merger, following the non-binding proposal of July 22, 2026: PAG's board approved the merger on October 14, 2026 (US time) on the recommendation of a special committee, and Motown Acquisition Corp., established by Penske Corporation and Mitsui & Co. for the transaction, entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with PAG. After completion Mitsui's ownership interest in PAG is expected to increase from approximately 20.3% to approximately 36% and Penske Corporation's from approximately 52.1% to approximately 64%, and PAG will be privately held by the two. Completion is expected in the last quarter of FY March 2027, subject to PAG shareholder approvals (a majority of outstanding shares and a majority of votes cast by disinterested stockholders) and required regulatory approvals. The company states the transaction was not included in its Medium-term Management Plan 2029 (May 2026); it expects a limited impact on FY March 2027 consolidated results and, from FY March 2028 onward, additional earnings contributions beyond the plan's assumptions from the higher ownership interest. Mitsui, which first invested in PAG in 2001, says it will support PAG's business development and create collaborative projects. PAG is an automotive and commercial-truck retailer (dealerships in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Italy, Australia and Japan; one of the largest retailers of Freightliner commercial trucks in North America) with sales of US$31,809 million in the fiscal year ended December 2025.
